decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The building shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of No. 48C Oxford Road South as a single family house.

Condition : 5 - Before the development herby approved is commenced, a scheme to protect the adjoining tree from the effects of building operations shall be implemented in accordance with details to be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Removal of the existing garden shed and replace with larger garden shed in the rear end of the garden to the house.
